events.verdict: Antetokounmpo (MIL) goes to, not through, Gallinari's (LAC) space as he drives into the lane.
Lopez (MIL) puts his right forearm to Williams' (LAC) front and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) cleanly deflects the pass intended for Harrell (LAC) in the lane.

RLB shows Antetokounmpo (MIL) seals Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) in the lane by putting both hands around his lower body. This contact is marginal in nature and does not affect Gilgeous-Alexander's FOM or ability to defend the play.

Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) puts both hands around Antetokounmpo's (MIL) hips and pulls him backwards towards the baseline as the drive toward the basket takes place. The crew communicated with the Replay Center to determine if the foul committed by the Clippers' Shai Gilgeous-Alexander occurred prior to the start of the shooting motion of the Bucks' Malcolm Brogdon. After review, it was determined that the foul occurred after the start of the shooting motion, and the basket was successful.
Middleton (MIL) sticks his left arm into Gilgeous-Alexander's (LAC) path and creates head contact, affecting his SQBR.
Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) puts his left forearm to Bledsoe's (MIL) front at the start of his drive and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR.
LLB shows Gilgeous-Alexander's (LAC) right hand makes contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) left arm but does not affect his shot attempt at the rim.
Harrell (LAC) sets the pick on Bledsoe (MIL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
As they cross half-court, Williams (LAC) delivers slight contact to Bledsoe (MIL) that does not affect his ability to defend the play.
Harrell (LAC) sets the pick on Bledsoe (MIL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Connaughton (MIL) sets the pick on Beverley (LAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Connaughton (MIL) establishes himself in Harrell's (LAC) defensive path and absorbs contact.

Gallinari (LAC) uses his right forearm to defend Antetokounmpo (MIL) during the drive, making marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR. Gallinari places his left hand on Antetokounmpo's opposite side hip after he picks up his dribble, but this is a tactile touch that does not affect his FOM.
Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball as Antetokounmpo (MIL) attempts to make the pass to Brogdon (MIL) in the corner.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) briefly engages and disengages with Beverley (LAC) as he slips the pick.
Bledsoe (MIL) slightly extends his off-arm into Gallinari's (LAC) front and makes marginal contact that does not affect his ability to defend.
Gallinari (LAC) establishes himself in Brogdon's (MIL) defensive path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Ilyasova (MIL) moves laterally into Williams' (LAC) path and affects his SQBR.
Harrell (LAC) sets the pick on Brogdon (MIL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) moves alongside Bledsoe (MIL) and maintains legal guarding position as contact is created by Bledsoe during the drive.
Bledsoe (MIL) makes incidental contact with Gallinari (LAC) as they attempt to retrieve the loose ball.
Gallinari (LAC) makes incidental contact with Brogdon (MIL) as they both get to the loose ball.
The crew communicated with the Replay Center to determine who the ball went out of bounds off of. Initially, the ruling was Bucks' ball, and after review the ruling was overturned to Clippers' ball.
During the drive, Connaughton (MIL) places his forearm against Gilgeous-Alexander's (LAC) side and a hand briefly to his arm, making marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) moves toward the perimeter and makes marginal contact with Gallinari (LAC) as he begins his drive.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) cleanly blocks Gallinari's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Gallinari (LAC) makes marginal contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) front during the driving shot attempt.
Williams (LAC) sets the screen on Brogdon (MIL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
After being drawn into the air on the pump-fake, Antetokounmpo (MIL) returns to the floor and makes incidental contact with Gallinari (LAC) that does not affect his SQBR.
Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) cleanly blocks Bledsoe's (MIL) driving shot attempt.
Bledsoe (MIL) briefly places his arm around Harrell's (LAC) opposite side but slides it off as they separate on the screen without affecting Harrell's SQBR.
Bledsoe (MIL) places his right forearm to Williams' (LAC) front and makes marginal contact prior to his gather.
Bledsoe (MIL) makes incidental contact with Williams (LAC) after the release and does not affect the shot attempt.
